[Act: succession
 Chapter: Of Specific Legacies
 Section: 149::Where deficiency of assets to pay legacies, specific legacy not to abate with general legacies.
]


If there is a deficiency of assets to pay legacies, a specific legacy is not liable to abate with the general legacies.
